title: Nazi Zombie Villa 2
author: Gbomb

scanner.why: no easter egg or ending found; default Round 20

baseline.note: A name counts as this map's own only if it is absent from WaW's own zone files AND from the boilerplate shared by most maps in the corpus. Built by archive/stock_baseline.py and fed to scan_map.scan(baseline_path=..., ignore=...).

archive.catalogue_description: Description nazi_zombie_villa2 is a large scale zombie map. From the original map Villa {eXg} Zombie, I’ve converted the map to a Shi No Numa style map. I’ve added lots of new features to keep it crazy. All new playing areas to open and explore. Villa offers all the best features of Shi No Numa. – All Shi No Numa sounds. – Flogger – All four perks – Lots of hell hounds. – Lots of un-lockable rooms and doors. – 4 Electric zapper placed throughout the map. – Easter eggs – Moving weapons box. – Bouncing Betty. – Lots of special effects and more!

notes: Replaces common scripts (maps/_callbackglobal.gsc, maps/_gameskill.gsc, maps/_laststand.gsc, maps/_load.gsc, maps/_loadout.gsc); re-verify the generic down/revive/score events on it. Ships 2 executable(s): $PLUGINSDIR/System.dll, $PLUGINSDIR/nsDialogs.dll. NEVER RUN THEM (dev-box.md rule 3). No finish found by name. Before accepting Round 20, someone should glance at this map's own triggers: toilet_flush, toilet_trig.origin.
